historical_record.description: The property was occupied by the business called Jet Hand Carwash and Detailing.
The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use under the Mission District Interim Controls to allow the construction of three market rate dwelling units.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the project as proposed, changing the use from a car washing business to three market-rate dwelling units.
